key_insight: Entire sig-jump-diffusions make expected signatures computable through linear ODEs, enabling score-based generative modeling for time series and finite-dimensional data.
engineering_relevance: The framework reduces generalized score learning for jump diffusions to linear ODE solves and deterministic optimization.
method: Define jump-diffusions whose characteristics are linear combinations of their own signature components.
Compute expected signatures via linear ODEs, with finite-dimensional systems for embedded polynomial jump-diffusions.
Learn scores through deterministic optimization or inverse signature matching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical computability and embedding results, but provides no datasets, empirical benchmarks, or quantitative generation metrics.
watch_item: General models involve potentially infinite signature expansions, so practical implementations may require truncation and numerical error control.
paper_title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
